metadata.description: Third-Party Risk Management framework extending DORA ICT third-party requirements (Articles 28-30)

requirements.title: ICT Third-Party Register
requirements.description: Maintain a register of all ICT third-party service providers supporting critical or important functions

requirements.title: Pre-contractual Risk Assessment
requirements.description: Conduct risk assessment before entering into contractual arrangements with ICT third-party providers

requirements.title: Contractual Minimum Clauses
requirements.description: Ensure contracts include audit rights, exit strategy, incident notification, SLA, and data location provisions

requirements.title: Concentration Risk Monitoring
requirements.description: Monitor and manage concentration risk from over-reliance on single ICT third-party providers

requirements.title: Sub-contracting Chain Oversight
requirements.description: Oversee and approve sub-contracting arrangements by ICT third-party providers

requirements.title: Ongoing Performance Monitoring
requirements.description: Continuously monitor ICT third-party provider performance and compliance with contractual obligations

assessmentCriteria.label: Documented exit strategy and transition plan
Service level agreements defined and monitored
